correctness.rationale: The specified adjacency is exactly the Hamiltonian 18-cycle plus the Pappus chords (5,7,−7,7,−7,−5) repeated three times. Enumeration by subsets of one bipartition side and allowed subsets of the other gives 2597 nonempty faces. The replay verifies 1293 disjoint matching pairs and exhaustively topologically sorts 11430 directed covers, leaving one vertex and ten 4-cells. The resulting Morse CW complex is a wedge of ten 4-spheres because the only attaching targets are the single vertex. For automorphisms, connectedness and bipartiteness fix the image side of the odd vertices once the image side of the evens is chosen. Enumerate both choices and all even-side bijections, extending only when each distinct neighborhood triple is transported to one on the other side. This exhausts 216 graph automorphisms. The signed fixed-face formula follows from chain-level trace equal to homological Lefschetz trace, with one subtracted for H0. The independent character replay sums over compatible permutation orbits: each orbit in a fixed face contributes one factor −1 in the reduced Euler sign convention, with the overall sign reversed. It reproduces the full histogram, trace sum 0 and square sum 432, so invariants vanish and the squared norm is two. After barycentric subdivision the quotient rational chains identify with coinvariants, and averaging identifies their homology with invariants. Thus the rational acyclicity conclusion is supported; the ordinary wedge equivalence need not be equivariant.
